checks.test: const find = (t) => $$('body *').filter((el) => el.children.length === 0 || el.matches('button, a')).find((el) => el.textContent.trim() === t); const el = find('Add to basket'); return !!el && !!el.closest('button');

const b = $$('button').find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Add to basket'); if (!b) return false; const before = Number(text('#basket-count')); await click(b); return Number(text('#basket-count')) === before + 1;

const find = (t) => $$('body *').filter((el) => el.children.length === 0 || el.matches('button, a')).find((el) => el.textContent.trim() === t); const el = find('Remove one'); const b = el && el.closest('button'); if (!b) return false; const before = Number(text('#basket-count')); await click(b); return Number(text('#basket-count')) === Math.max(0, before - 1);

const find = (t) => $$('body *').filter((el) => el.children.length === 0 || el.matches('button, a')).find((el) => el.textContent.trim() === t); const el = find('See the Friday line-up'); const a = el && el.closest('a[href]'); return !!a && a.getAttribute('href').endsWith('#lineup');
